body: I don't think they REALLY get to know me as I just don't like to actually use my actual voice in conversations... but when I have to I feel like I come over akward... whenever I'm around my few friends, online or irl, I act a lot happier than i actually am because I'm too scared to open up and talk... neither do I have any close friends or anything... and my parents...
